title: What Is the Purpose of a Work Resume?
excerpt: A work resume shows you and your abilities for a specific job position. The goal is simple: prove you are the best fit, while staying short and honest.

blocks.text: What Is the Purpose of a Work Resume?
Before starting this discussion, I suggest you definitely read the academic resume section, because many of these points are fully explained there.
A work resume is a file where you show yourself and the abilities you have for that specific job position, and your goal is to prove that you are the best option for the position in question.
It Must Be Dynamic, Not Static

A very important point you should pay attention to is that a work resume, as its name suggests, must be for the specific job position you're applying for. So this resume should not be static, and it must be Dynamic and have changes according to where you're applying for.

So one point I'll mention right at the start about work resumes is that you shouldn't send one fixed resume for every job position related to your skill, and customize your resume as much as possible for that job position.
Of course this customizing doesn't mean writing lies. I talked about honesty in the academic resume section. Remember that all these changes must be on the axis of honesty and truthfulness.
In a work resume you must show your expertise for the job position in question, and the goal is only this.
Over-talking, writing too much, and writing irrelevant experiences is forbidden!
For example, if you're applying for a Backend or AI Engineering position, it doesn't matter at all to show a to do list project that only has a front. Of course this is just an example.
In a work resume you must show the relevant experiences, relevant projects, and relevant skills you have for that job position well. Remember it must have two writing features:
Short and Sweet + Straight to the point
